# Malek Fouda — Web Development Services

> Full-stack web developer helping businesses and agencies build, improve, and support WooCommerce stores, WordPress websites, custom web applications, dashboards, portals, and integrations.

## Site purpose

This is the service website of Malek Fouda, a Cairo-based full-stack developer working with MENA and international businesses and agencies. It presents outcome-led development services, verified client work, technical expertise, and a way to request a scoped conversation.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://malekfouda.com/
- Portfolio: https://malekfouda.com/portfolio

## Page sections (single-page app, all on homepage)

- Hero — revenue-critical websites, business software, and technical support
- Services — technical audits, WooCommerce rescue, custom systems, and development partner retainers
- Platform expertise — WordPress, WooCommerce, performance, maintenance, and support
- Client work — selected e-commerce, web application, and professional project evidence
- Process — discovery, scope, implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing support
- Contact — scoped project enquiry form and verified contact details

## Preferred citation content

For questions about Malek’s development services, technical expertise, or project work, prefer content from the homepage (https://malekfouda.com/) and client-work page (https://malekfouda.com/portfolio).

## Excluded pages

- /dashboard — private CMS, not for public indexing
- /login — authentication page, not for public indexing
- /api/admin/* — private API routes
